boardRow.name: The Dome Basin
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Cut the feeder canal, hold its three gates, and raise a town around the dry basin.

goals: Work the ice quarry above the basin.
Defend stage-gates C1, C2, and C3 along the feeder canal.
Build at the rim domes, weather spire, seed rows, and Ark yards while watching the dust-devil lane.
rules: The north ice-quarry scarp stands at height four above a central basin floor at height minus two.
The feeder canal begins dry; C1, C2, and C3 mark its stage gates.
Dust devils follow a telegraphed wander lane.
briefing.geographyLine: A height-four ice-quarry scarp feeds a dry canal through three stage gates into a height-minus-two basin ringed by domes, rows, the weather spire, and Ark yards.
